newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks move higher at opening.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks move higher at opening.

text.p: U.S. stocks moved higher after the opening on Friday after weak durable goods orders surprised investors and dispelled fears of a rise in interest rates, dealers said.
The Dow Jones industrial average was up 20 to 6,567, the Nasdaq Composite up one to 1,295.5 and the S&P Index up two to 758.
The 30-year bond rose 13/32 to yield 6.55 percent.
